newsitem.title: UK: BP shares pare losses after trading statement.
newsitem.headline: BP shares pare losses after trading statement.

text.p: British Petroleum Co Plc shares pared their losses on Wednesday after the company released a bullish trading statement, dealers said.
The shares were three pence lower at 707-1/2 by 1110 GMT after being 11-1/2p weaker before the trading statement.
BP said its target to improve underlying annual income by $1.5 billion a year by the end of the decade could be achieved at least a year ahead of schedule.
It said it could grow production by five percent a year over the next decade and replace its higher output with annual additions of new reserves.
